scope: Fresh generated shared source to native executable through the GHC-hosted MLF crate-fused-v1 endpoint; fixed builtin/runtime dependencies prepared separately for each compiler outside timing.
timing_boundary: exact-child worker launch through wait4; common Python dispatcher included; preparation and validation excluded
ratio_definition: Ratio of the three full-build wall-time medians for each lane; not the median of individual paired ratios and not source-to-LLVM-only time.

claim_limits: Two pairs per cell provide quick feedback. Per-cell spread describes the observed runs on one machine.
Each comparison applies to the measured fixtures and sizes on that machine.
Different cohorts are separate windows and are never pooled into one median.

endpoint.cache_boundary: each leg gets a private, empty query cache directory that is inventoried and deleted after correctness checks; no target objects, .hi/.o files, LLVM or executables are reused between legs
endpoint.summary: GHC-hosted single-invocation checked crate to LLVM; publishes the same checked object and query cache, then links the retained checked root. Separate from the two-process crate-bootstrap-v1 endpoint.

schedule.order: candidate between GHC and the committed compiler, reversing each round; interleaved cells

builtin.origin: prepared by the public crate path

builtin_record.origin: prepared by the public crate path

limitations: Two positive sizes (16,64) do not establish the growth/slope/exponent acceptance gate, which requires baseline-0 and at least three positive sizes.
Several size16 full-build medians and several baseline RSS comparisons regress; no universal speedup or memory reduction is claimed.
Each timed process is short; startup, filesystem and host noise are material. Three repetitions give medians, not a robust confidence bound on the before/after difference.
This cohort does not measure an installed/self-hosted compiler or a full compiler rebuild, and does not establish the parent-workload performance objective.
The earlier cohort with cross-ABI baseline failures and the interrupted dependency preparation were retained and excluded, never relabeled as successful samples.
